summary: Contract phase only, zero implementation added. Freezes the Repository Skills contract 115H designed -- the RepositorySkill interface, capability model, manifest, five determinism classes, a two-outcome failure contract, an execution boundary, an advisory/AI skill boundary, a composition model, explainability requirements, and a now-frozen canonical wire diagram. The RepositorySkill interface requires every skill to declare capabilities, evidence categories produced, determinism class, confidence defaults, and required repository inputs, and to produce only an EvidenceCollection. Explicitly and permanently forbidden: repository mutation, decision making, validator bypass, lifecycle authority, artifact promotion, notification dispatch, execution, authorization, commit, push, finalize. RepositorySkillCapability describes evidence outputs, never implementations: git_analysis, runtime_analysis, architecture_analysis, documentation_analysis, report_analysis, metadata_analysis, dependency_analysis, ai_review. Five determinism classes reuse 115C's existing EvidenceDeterminism enum with no new member. The failure contract requires honest UNKNOWN evidence or an explicit failure outcome -- never partial hidden failure, never silent success. The advisory/AI boundary governs any future DeepSeek/GLM/GPT/Qwen/local-SLM-backed skill: advisory evidence only, probabilistic by default, labelled model-produced, never sole authority for Accept, never bypasses Decision Evaluation. No Repository Skill implemented, no deterministic skill implemented, no AI/SLM/LLM-backed skill implemented, no DeepSeek integration, no changes to Evidence Providers, Decision Evaluation, the Repository Transition Validator, lifecycle commands, Notification Policy, Canonical Artifact Promotion, Push-State Reconciliation, or Post-Push Canonicalization. Execution capability remains unavailable.
